A '''star system''' contained [[Torn Station]], a [[Fuel/Legends|refueling]] [[Space station/Legends|station]] that various [[Slaver/Legends|slavers]], [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]], and [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] had hideouts on. The [[Star system/Legends|system]] was filled with tumbling [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroids]] and [[Comet/Legends|comets]].<ref name="TEA" />

The system was located in the [[Mytaranor sector/Legends|Mytaranor sector]], a part of the [[Kashyyyk Region/Legends|Kashyyyk Region]] in [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] section of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]. A [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] called the [[Great Kashyyyk Branch/Legends|Great Kashyyyk Branch]] connected Torn Station and the system to the [[Kashyyyk system/Legends|Kashyyyk]] and [[Quas Killam system/Legends|Quas Killam systems]].<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
The system that held Torn Station was first mentioned in ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', a [[2009]] reference book written by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed the system in the grid square P-10.<ref name="TEA" />
